# tools/loc/cs-literal-budget.txt
#
# The ratchet for Phase 2 of docs/localization-plan.md: how many bare English
# UI literals each C# file is still allowed to hold. One '<repo-relative path>
# <count>' line per file, sorted by count. Generated by
# tools/loc/sweep-cs.ps1 -WriteBudget and enforced by that script and by
# LocCsLiteralBudget in src/TrueforceForAll.Core.Tests/LocalizationTests.cs.
#
# A number only ever goes down, and a file that is not listed must hold none.
# Converting a label lowers its file's line in the same commit, and the check
# fails on slack as well as on excess, so the numbers stay true. Phase 2 is
# provably done the day this file holds no entries.
#
# One legitimate reason a number goes up: a new rule in cs-ui-sinks.txt makes the
# sweep see writes it was blind to. Re-run with -WriteBudget in that commit and
# say so in the message.
#
# Written 2026-09-26 from 126 plugin file(s): 1555 literal(s) left.
